The '''P8 Lamprey''' was a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] model in use during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. It received its unusual nickname for the vicious-looking end of the barrel,<ref name="Card-SWGTCG-P8 Lamprey Pistol">{{SWGTCG|set=The Price of Victory|cardname=P8 Lamprey Pistol}}</ref> wide mouth, and long stylized sights that resembled fins. The pistol's projectiles released an acidic compound upon impact that was dangerous to both biological and mechanical entities. The schematic for the weapon was discovered by a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] during the [[Retaking of the Blackguard|mission to retake]] the rogue [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] known as the [[Blackguard (Star Destroyer)|''Blackguard'']].<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The P8 Lamprey pistol appears in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. It was added to the game on [[January 15]], [[2008]] with the release of the ''Chapter 8: The Nova Orion Crisis'' game update. It is obtained by looting the schematic for it from the corpse of any of the "boss" level enemies the player defeats during the retaking of the Star Destroyer ''Blackguard''. The player may then bring the schematic to another player of the Munitions [[Merchant/Legends|Trader]] profession and have that player craft the weapon for them. The pistol also appears as a "Weapon" card in the [[The Price of Victory|''Price of Victory'']] expansion set for the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]''. The expansion was released on [[December 14]], [[2010]].
